To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of a solar air collector is a good alternative to the use of solar water collector for drying purposes; (2) the use of the biomass as insulation material is a good option to improve the performance of the solar air collector; (3) the use of fins in solar air collector improves the thermal performance; and (4) the thermal performance of the solar collector is influenced by the solar radiation and mass flow rate.
the performance of the solar air heater with fins is influenced by the air velocity and the solar irradiance.
the double-pass solar air heater with fins has the best performance among the three configurations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a double-pass solar air heater with a local material made of millet stalks for air heating.
the development of an innovative double-pass solar air heater (DPSAH) with and without fins.
the development of a solar collector double pass with fins to produce air hot to improve the drying techniques in the region of Sidi Slimane, Morocco.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the double-pass solar air heater with finned absorber has a better thermal performance than a double-pass solar air collector without fins.
the solar air collector with and without fins, is a promising device to produce air at high temperature, which can be used to improve the efficiency of solar dryers.
the solar air double pass collector with fins is the best choice for solar drying.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a solar air collector with double pass and with fins, we have studied the heat transfer between the air and the absorber, and we have estimated the heat exchange coefficients.
we have developed a solar air heater with a double pass configuration with and without fins.
we have developed a solar air double pass collector and we have studied its thermal performances.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have successfully designed, developed and optimized a solar air collector.
a solar collector is a device that is used to collect the solar radiation and convert the energy into heat.
the use of a double pass solar collector with fins can improve the performance of the collector.
